core_obligations: Colimit preservation via the left-adjointness of the stalk functors and categories-lemma-adjoint-exact.
Exactness on sheaves from the definition of a point; exactness on presheaves by composition with exact sheafification.
proof_roadmap: Sites point lemmas + adjoint colimit preservation + exact sheafification composition
difficulty_reason: Citation assembly with articulated arrows: (1) from Sites, Lemma sites-lemma-point-pushforward-sheaf; the presheaf and sheaf stalk functors are left adjoints (Sites, sites-lemma-adjoint-point-push-stalk and the point-pushforward lemma), hence commute with arbitrary colimits by Categories, Lemma categories-lemma-adjoint-exact; the sheaf stalk functor is exact by the definition of a point of a site (Sites, Definition sites-definition-point); composing with exact sheafification (Sites, Lemma sites-lemma-sheafification-exact) gives exactness on presheaves.
